text:
eva_pm: Quick sync — pricing & quota fields for the new 'priority lanes' initiative. Customers are asking for per-route reserved capacity, predictable token accounting for embeddings and tool/function calls, and clearer burst credits. Need launch checklist and an API contract proposal.

shreya_prod: TL;DR — we need both API surface + console UX. Proposing a new per-route reference to a quota profile (so we don't bake tons of fields into routes). Profile includes: priority_tier, reserved_qps, burst_credits, token_quota.

mike_eng: Prefer referencing a saved profile (less breaking). Implementation notes: token accounting isn't trivial because batching + KV cache change effective tokens. We can surface server-side accounting and expose metrics first, avoid adding token headers in v1. :thinking_face:

darren_research: For embeddings: customers want deterministic spend. Token-based billing for embeddings is confusing. Propose we add an 'embedding_unit' in the profile (e.g., units per 1k vectors) and translate internally to tokens for infra. That gives stable pricing semantics.

olivia_sales: Enterprise asks we've logged: deterministic SLA (reserved QPS + burst pockets), bundled burst credits for month, and per-tool-call cost visibility (some tool calls fan-out to multiple models). They also want a sandbox cost estimator. :thumbsup:

mike_eng: Two implementation options: A) extend route schema with full quota fields B) reference quota_profile_id on route. I vote B — easier rollback and enables sharing profiles across routes and customers. Also propose a small request-level override header `X-Quota-Profile` for temporary experiments.

eva_pm: Agree on profile-first approach. Migration plan: create default profiles that map 1:1 with current behavior so no surprise on upgrade. Launch criteria: API stable + profile CRUD, Console binding UI, telemetry (per-profile cost & latency), billing pipeline integration, doc migration guide, and e2e compatibility tests.

shreya_prod: Docs checklist: samples for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, function-calls, and structured output. Important callout — structured outputs: how do we count tokens for serialized JSON vs pre-structured blocks? We need a clear rule (input+output tokens billed?) and an example to avoid disputes.

darren_research: Historically we bill input + output tokens. Suggest we keep that but include `estimated_token_breakdown` in response metadata for v1 of profiles so customers can reconcile charges. That will also help runtime caching and optimistic billing.

olivia_sales: Also make the Console estimator show both token-based and unit-based views (for embeddings/profiles). Sales need exporting a sample CSV of predicted monthly spend for contracts.

quota-bot: Reminder: follow-up actions captured. Engineering to open design PR, product to draft launch checklist, docs to start migration guide.

mike_eng: I'll open the design PR today with proto for quota_profile_id + minimal API: PATCH /routes/{id}/quota_profile -> {"profile_id": "uuid"}. Also proposing a small header `X-Quota-Profile: <profile_id>` for per-request overrides (opt-in). Example payload in PR: ```json
{
  "profile_id": "qp_1234",
  "priority_tier": "gold",
  "reserved_qps": 150,
  "burst_credits": 10000,
  "token_quota_per_min": 300000
}
```

eva_pm: Perfect — include migration note in changelog and a deprecation timeline if we ever replace per-route fields. Meeting tomorrow 10:00 to sign off on PR + checklist. Thanks everyone.
